_comment: INSTRUCTIONS: Merge only the 'mcpServers' block below into your existing ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json — do NOT replace the entire file. Steps: (1) Replace /PATH/TO/priorauth-assist with the absolute path to this repo on your machine. (2) Run 'mvn package -DskipTests' in the repo root to build the JAR. (3) The FHIR server must be running before starting Claude Desktop. For local Docker: see Step 1 in README. For the cluster FHIR server: run 'kubectl port-forward -n priorauth-fhir svc/priorauth-fhir 8080:8080' and leave it running. (4) Restart Claude Desktop after editing the config.
